name: ld2410c
title: HLK-LD2410C 24 GHz presence radar
notes: The UART runs at 256000 baud, 1 stop bit. OUT is high while someone is there: a pin for it is a choice, the UART is enough.
Its own Bluetooth is on by default.

facts.source: HLK-LD2410C datasheet: 5 to 12 V, 5 V advised, more than 200 mA, IO level 3.3 V, UART 256000, module 16 x 22 mm
